sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 3371
Sahih al-Bukhari records the Prophet ﷺ using this dual wording for al-Hasan and al-Husayn and mentions Ibrahim's protection of Ismail and Ishaq.

daily_break_fast.title: Upon Breaking the Fast
daily_break_fast.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
daily_break_fast.meaningEn: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
daily_break_fast.purposeEn: The remembrance reported from the Prophet ﷺ when he broke his fast.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 2357; Hisn al-Muslim 176
Abu Dawud 2357 is graded Hasan by Al-Albani and contains this wording.

daily_visit_sick_purification.title: When Visiting the Sick — Purification, Allah Willing
daily_visit_sick_purification.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ، طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
daily_visit_sick_purification.meaningEn: No harm; a purification, if Allah wills.
daily_visit_sick_purification.purposeEn: Words of reassurance the Prophet ﷺ said when visiting the sick.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 5656, 5662
Recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari in the context of visiting a sick person.

daily_visit_sick_healing_7.title: When Visiting the Sick — Ask Allah for Healing Seven Times
daily_visit_sick_healing_7.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
daily_visit_sick_healing_7.meaningEn: I ask Allah the Magnificent, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to heal you.
daily_visit_sick_healing_7.purposeEn: Supplication for the recovery of a sick person.
daily_visit_sick_healing_7.whenToSayEn: When visiting a sick person whose appointed time of death has not come.
daily_visit_sick_healing_7.practiceEn: Recite seven times, as stated in the cited report.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 3106; Hisn al-Muslim 148
Abu Dawud 3106 is graded Sahih by Al-Albani and explicitly states seven repetitions.

daily_healing_remove_harm.title: For Illness — Remove the Harm and Heal
daily_healing_remove_harm.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
daily_healing_remove_harm.meaningEn: O Allah, Lord of the people, remove the harm and heal; You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness.
daily_healing_remove_harm.purposeEn: A supplication the Prophet ﷺ used when treating or visiting the sick.
daily_healing_remove_harm.whenToSayEn: When supplicating for a sick person.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 5675, 5743
Recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari with closely matching wording in the patient and ruqyah chapters.

daily_graves_greeting.title: When Visiting Graves
daily_graves_greeting.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَلَاحِقُونَ، أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
daily_graves_greeting.meaningEn: Peace be upon you, inhabitants of these dwellings, from among the believers and Muslims. Allah willing, we will join you. I ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.
daily_graves_greeting.purposeEn: The greeting and supplication taught for visiting graveyards.
sources: Sahih Muslim 975
Sahih Muslim records this wording in the chapter on what is said when entering graveyards.

daily_difficult_affairs.title: When an Affair Becomes Difficult
daily_difficult_affairs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
daily_difficult_affairs.meaningEn: O Allah, there is no ease except what You make easy, and You make difficulty easy if You will.
daily_difficult_affairs.purposeEn: Asking Allah to make a difficult matter easy.
sources: Sahih Ibn Hibban 2427; Ibn as-Sunni 351; Hisn al-Muslim 139
Hisn al-Muslim notes Ibn Hajar's authentication and the authentication of Abdul-Qadir al-Arnaut for this report.

prophetic_istikhara.title: Salat al-Istikhara — Guidance in a Decision
prophetic_istikhara.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ رَضِّنِي بِهِ
prophetic_istikhara.meaningEn: O Allah, I seek the better choice through Your knowledge, and I seek ability through Your power, and I ask You from Your immense bounty. You are able and I am not; You know and I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know this matter to be good for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affair—now and later—then decree it for me. If You know it to be bad for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affair—now and later—then turn it away from me and turn me away from it. Decree the good for me wherever it is, then make me content with it.
prophetic_istikhara.transliteration: Allāhumma innī astakhīruka biʿilmika, wa astaqdiruka biqudratika, wa asʾaluka min faḍlikal-ʿaẓīm. Fa-innaka taqdiru wa lā aqdir, wa taʿlamu wa lā aʿlam, wa anta ʿAllāmul-ghuyūb. Allāhumma in kunta taʿlamu anna hādhal-amra khayrun lī fī dīnī wa maʿāshī wa ʿāqibati amrī — aw qāla: ʿājili amrī wa ājilih — faqdurhu lī. Wa in kunta taʿlamu anna hādhal-amra sharrun lī fī dīnī wa maʿāshī wa ʿāqibati amrī — aw qāla: fī ʿājili amrī wa ājilih — faṣrifhu ʿannī waṣrifnī ʿanhu, waqdur liyal-khayra ḥaythu kāna, thumma raḍḍinī bih.
prophetic_istikhara.purposeEn: Seeking Allah's guidance and decree when deciding a permissible matter.
prophetic_istikhara.whenToSayEn: After two non-obligatory rakʿahs when seeking Allah's guidance concerning a permissible matter; name the matter where the hadith indicates.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 6382

Jabir reported that the Prophet ﷺ taught Istikhara like a surah of the Quran: pray two non-obligatory rakʿahs, say this supplication, and mention the matter. The two alternative hadith wordings about the outcome of the affair are preserved in the Arabic instead of silently choosing one.

daily_fear_people_protection.title: When Afraid of a People — Allah as Protection
daily_fear_people_protection.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
daily_fear_people_protection.meaningEn: O Allah, we place You before them as our protection, and we seek refuge in You from their evils.
daily_fear_people_protection.transliteration: Allāhumma innā najʿaluka fī nuḥūrihim, wa naʿūdhu bika min shurūrihim.
daily_fear_people_protection.purposeEn: Seeking Allah's protection when fearing harm from people.
daily_fear_people_protection.whenToSayEn: When fearing harm from a group of people.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 1537
Abu Musa al-Ashʿari reported that the Prophet ﷺ said this when he feared a group of people. The report is graded Sahih by Al-Albani.

daily_fear_ruler_ibn_masud_companion.title: Fear of an Oppressive Ruler — Companion Practice of Ibn Masʿud
daily_fear_ruler_ibn_masud_companion.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَارًا مِنْ فُلَانِ ابْنِ فُلَانٍ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ أَنْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
daily_fear_ruler_ibn_masud_companion.meaningEn: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Mighty Throne, be my Protector from so-and-so son of so-and-so and his followers among Your creation, from jinn and mankind, lest any of them act hastily against me or transgress. Mighty is Your protection, exalted is Your praise, and none has the right to be worshipped except You.
daily_fear_ruler_ibn_masud_companion.transliteration: Allāhumma Rabbas-samāwātis-sabʿi wa Rabbal-ʿArshil-ʿAẓīm, kun lī jāran min fulānin ibni fulānin wa atbāʿihi min khalqika, minal-jinni wal-insi, an yafruṭa ʿalayya aḥadun minhum aw an yaṭghā. ʿAzza jāruka wa jalla thanāʾuka, lā ilāha illā anta.
daily_fear_ruler_ibn_masud_companion.purposeEn: A Companion-sourced supplication for protection from an oppressive authority.
daily_fear_ruler_ibn_masud_companion.whenToSayEn: A Companion-sourced supplication for fear of an oppressive ruler; it is not stored as a direct Prophetic hadith.
sources: Sahih at-Targhib 2237 (mawquf report from ʿAbdullah ibn Masʿud)

Al-Albani graded this mawquf report Sahih. A marfuʿ route attributing a related wording directly to the Prophet ﷺ has differing/weak grading, so the app stores this only as Companion practice and does not call it a Prophetic dua.

daily_against_enemies_defeat.title: Against Enemies — Defeat and Shake Them
daily_against_enemies_defeat.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الْأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
daily_against_enemies_defeat.meaningEn: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, swift in reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and shake them.
daily_against_enemies_defeat.transliteration: Allāhumma munzilal-kitāb, sarīʿal-ḥisāb, ihzimil-aḥzāb. Allāhumma ihzimhum wa zalzilhum.
daily_against_enemies_defeat.purposeEn: Asking Allah for victory and protection against hostile enemies.
daily_against_enemies_defeat.whenToSayEn: When facing an enemy and asking Allah for victory.
sources: Sahih Muslim 1742b
Sahih Muslim records the Prophet ﷺ making this supplication against the confederate forces.

daily_afraid_group_suffice_me.title: When Afraid of a Group — Suffice Me Against Them
daily_afraid_group_suffice_me.meaningEn: O Allah, suffice me against them however You will.
daily_afraid_group_suffice_me.purposeEn: Seeking Allah's sufficiency and protection against threatening people.
daily_afraid_group_suffice_me.whenToSayEn: When asking Allah to suffice and protect you against a threatening group.
sources: Sahih Muslim 3005

This wording is spoken by the believing boy within the authentic story narrated by the Prophet ﷺ. It is therefore source-authentic within a Prophetic narration, but the app does not mislabel it as a personal supplication directly uttered by the Prophet ﷺ.

daily_faith_doubt_belief.title: When Afflicted by Doubt in Faith — I Believe in Allah
daily_faith_doubt_belief.purposeEn: Responding to intrusive doubts with faith and disengaging from the whispering.
daily_faith_doubt_belief.whenToSayEn: When confronted by the whispering question about who created Allah; also seek refuge with Allah and stop pursuing the thought.
daily_faith_doubt_belief.practiceEn: Say this statement of faith. Sahih Muslim 134c separately instructs seeking refuge with Allah and stopping the line of thought.
sources: Sahih Muslim 134a; Sahih Muslim 134c

Sahih Muslim 134a explicitly instructs saying 'I believe in Allah.' Sahih Muslim 134c instructs seeking refuge with Allah and stopping the intrusive line of thought. The app keeps those instructions distinct rather than inventing a longer fixed formula.

daily_mishap_qadar.title: When Stricken by a Mishap — Allah's Decree
daily_mishap_qadar.meaningEn: This is Allah’s decree, and whatever He wills He does.
daily_mishap_qadar.purposeEn: Submitting to Allah's decree after a matter has already occurred.
daily_mishap_qadar.whenToSayEn: After an unwanted event has occurred, instead of dwelling on 'if only' statements.
sources: Sahih Muslim 2664
Sahih Muslim instructs the believer to say this after an affliction rather than saying 'if only,' which opens the door to Satan's work.

daily_end_of_life_highest_companion.title: Near the End of Life — Join Me with the Highest Companion
daily_end_of_life_highest_companion.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى
daily_end_of_life_highest_companion.meaningEn: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, and join me with the Highest Companion.
daily_end_of_life_highest_companion.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī warḥamnī wa alḥiqnī bir-Rafīqil-Aʿlā.
daily_end_of_life_highest_companion.purposeEn: Seeking forgiveness, mercy, and the Highest Companion near death.
daily_end_of_life_highest_companion.whenToSayEn: A supplication authentically reported from the Prophet ﷺ during his final illness.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 5674
Aishah reported hearing the Prophet ﷺ say this while resting against her during his final illness.

daily_dying_talqin_tawhid.title: For One Nearing Death — Prompt the Testimony of Tawhid
daily_dying_talqin_tawhid.meaningEn: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.
daily_dying_talqin_tawhid.purposeEn: The phrase the Prophet ﷺ instructed people to prompt the dying to say.
daily_dying_talqin_tawhid.whenToSayEn: For those present with a Muslim who is nearing death.
daily_dying_talqin_tawhid.practiceEn: Gently prompt the dying person to say this phrase; this card is an instruction/remembrance, not a supplication addressed to Allah.
sources: Sahih Muslim 916a; Sahih Muslim 917
Sahih Muslim records the Prophetic instruction to prompt those who are dying to say 'La ilaha illallah.' The app labels this as talqin guidance rather than a personal dua.

daily_calamity_reward_replacement.title: When Afflicted by a Calamity — Reward and Better Replacement
daily_calamity_reward_replacement.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
daily_calamity_reward_replacement.meaningEn: Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with something better than it.
daily_calamity_reward_replacement.transliteration: Innā lillāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūn. Allāhummaʾjurnī fī muṣībatī wa akhlif lī khayran minhā.
daily_calamity_reward_replacement.purposeEn: Seeking reward from Allah and a better replacement after calamity.
daily_calamity_reward_replacement.whenToSayEn: When a calamity or serious loss occurs.
sources: Sahih Muslim 918b
Umm Salama reported this exact instruction from the Prophet ﷺ and said she used it after Abu Salama's death.

daily_deceased_abu_salama_exact.title: After Closing the Eyes of the Deceased — Exact Dua for Abu Salama
daily_deceased_abu_salama_exact.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَبِي سَلَمَةَ، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ
daily_deceased_abu_salama_exact.meaningEn: O Allah, forgive Abu Salama, raise his rank among the rightly guided, take care of those he leaves behind among those who remain, forgive us and him, Lord of the worlds, make his grave spacious, and give him light in it.
daily_deceased_abu_salama_exact.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir li-Abī Salamata, warfaʿ darajatahu fil-mahdiyyīn, wakhlufhu fī ʿaqibihi fil-ghābirīn, waghfir lanā wa lahu yā Rabbal-ʿālamīn, wafsaḥ lahu fī qabrihi, wa nawwir lahu fīh.
daily_deceased_abu_salama_exact.purposeEn: The supplication the Prophet ﷺ made for Abu Salama immediately after his death.
daily_deceased_abu_salama_exact.whenToSayEn: The Prophet ﷺ said this after closing Abu Salama's eyes. The stored Arabic preserves Abu Salama's name exactly as transmitted.
daily_deceased_abu_salama_exact.practiceEn: This is exact source wording for Abu Salama. Do not present a name/pronoun adaptation for another deceased as though it were the verbatim hadith text.
sources: Sahih Muslim 920a

Sahih Muslim records that the Prophet ﷺ closed Abu Salama's eyes and then made this supplication. Because the transmitted Arabic names Abu Salama specifically, the app preserves that exact wording instead of silently generalizing it.

daily_janazah_forgive_mercy_cleanse.title: Funeral Prayer — Forgive, Have Mercy, Cleanse, and Admit to Paradise
daily_janazah_forgive_mercy_cleanse.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ أَوْ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ
daily_janazah_forgive_mercy_cleanse.meaningEn: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him; grant him well-being and pardon him; honor his reception and make his entrance spacious; wash him with water, snow, and hail; cleanse him of sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt; replace his home with a better home, his family with a better family, and his spouse with a better spouse; admit him to Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave or the punishment of the Fire.
daily_janazah_forgive_mercy_cleanse.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lahu warḥamhu, wa ʿāfihi waʿfu ʿanhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassiʿ mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bil-māʾi wath-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqihi minal-khaṭāyā kamā naqqaytath-thawbal-abyaḍa minad-danas, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, wa zawjan khayran min zawjihi, wa adkhilhul-jannah, wa aʿidhhu min ʿadhābil-qabri aw min ʿadhābin-nār.
daily_janazah_forgive_mercy_cleanse.purposeEn: A comprehensive authentic supplication for the deceased in the funeral prayer.
sources: Sahih Muslim 963a-b
Awf ibn Malik reported hearing the Prophet ﷺ make this supplication in the funeral prayer and wishing that he himself had been the deceased because of the supplication's comprehensiveness.

daily_child_janazah_abu_hurayrah_compani.title: Funeral Prayer for a Child — Companion Practice of Abu Hurayrah
daily_child_janazah_abu_hurayrah_compani.meaningEn: O Allah, protect him from the punishment of the grave.
daily_child_janazah_abu_hurayrah_compani.purposeEn: A Companion-sourced supplication for a child in the funeral prayer.
daily_child_janazah_abu_hurayrah_compani.whenToSayEn: A supplication authentically reported from Abu Hurayrah when he prayed over a child.
sources: Muwatta Malik, Book 16, Hadith 18 (Arabic ref. 540); Mishkat al-Masabih 1689

Saʿid ibn al-Musayyab reported hearing Abu Hurayrah say this while praying over a child. The report is displayed as Sahih in the cited Mishkat grading. It is a Companion practice, not a direct Prophetic hadith.

daily_condolence_allah_takes_gives.title: Condolence — To Allah Belongs What He Takes and Gives
daily_condolence_allah_takes_gives.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلٌّ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
daily_condolence_allah_takes_gives.meaningEn: To Allah belongs what He has taken and what He has given, and everything with Him has an appointed term. So be patient and seek Allah's reward.
daily_condolence_allah_takes_gives.transliteration: Inna lillāhi mā akhadha, wa lahu mā aʿṭā, wa kullun ʿindahu bi-ajalin musamman, faltaṣbir waltaḥtasib.
daily_condolence_allah_takes_gives.purposeEn: Authentic words of condolence and encouragement to patience and reward.
daily_condolence_allah_takes_gives.whenToSayEn: When consoling someone during bereavement or a dying relative's final moments.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 1284
The Prophet ﷺ sent these words to his daughter when her child was dying, instructing her to be patient and seek Allah's reward.

daily_placing_deceased_grave.title: When Placing the Deceased in the Grave
daily_placing_deceased_grave.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
daily_placing_deceased_grave.meaningEn: In the name of Allah, and upon the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.
daily_placing_deceased_grave.purposeEn: The transmitted remembrance when the deceased is placed in the grave.
daily_placing_deceased_grave.whenToSayEn: When placing the deceased into the grave.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 3213
Ibn Umar reported this wording from the Prophet ﷺ when the deceased was placed in the grave. The report is graded Sahih by Al-Albani.

daily_wind_storm_good_refuge.title: During a Wind Storm — Ask for Its Good and Seek Refuge from Its Evil
daily_wind_storm_good_refuge.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
daily_wind_storm_good_refuge.meaningEn: O Allah, I ask You for its good, the good within it, and the good for which it was sent; and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil within it, and the evil for which it was sent.
daily_wind_storm_good_refuge.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa khayra mā fīhā, wa khayra mā ursilat bih, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, wa sharri mā fīhā, wa sharri mā ursilat bih.
daily_wind_storm_good_refuge.purposeEn: Seeking the good of the wind and Allah's protection from its harm.
daily_wind_storm_good_refuge.whenToSayEn: When the wind becomes strong or stormy.
sources: Sahih Muslim 899b
Aishah reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used this supplication when the wind was stormy.

daily_thunder_ibn_al_zubayr_companion.title: Upon Hearing Thunder — Companion Practice of ʿAbdullah ibn al-Zubayr
daily_thunder_ibn_al_zubayr_companion.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
daily_thunder_ibn_al_zubayr_companion.meaningEn: Glory be to the One whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels out of fear of Him.
daily_thunder_ibn_al_zubayr_companion.transliteration: Subḥānal-ladhī yusabbiḥur-raʿdu biḥamdihi wal-malāʾikatu min khīfatih.
daily_thunder_ibn_al_zubayr_companion.purposeEn: A Companion-sourced remembrance upon hearing thunder.
sources: Al-Adab al-Mufrad 723; al-Albani, Sahih al-Adab al-Mufrad 556

Authentically reported as a mawquf practice of ʿAbdullah ibn al-Zubayr. It is not presented as a Prophetic dua. The related marfuʿ thunder supplication in Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 3450 is weak and is not used here.

daily_rain_request_ghayth.title: Asking for Rain — Beneficial Rain Without Harm
daily_rain_request_ghayth.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا مَرِيئًا مَرِيعًا نَافِعًا غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ عَاجِلًا غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
daily_rain_request_ghayth.meaningEn: O Allah, give us rain that brings relief, wholesome, fertile and beneficial, not harmful, immediately and without delay.
daily_rain_request_ghayth.transliteration: Allāhumma-sqinā ghaythan mughīthan marīʾan marīʿan nāfiʿan ghayra ḍārrin ʿājilan ghayra ājil.
daily_rain_request_ghayth.purposeEn: Asking Allah for prompt, beneficial rain that causes no harm.
daily_rain_request_ghayth.whenToSayEn: When asking Allah for rain during drought or need.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 1169
The report records this supplication for rain and is graded Sahih by al-Albani.

daily_rain_request_servants_animals.title: Asking for Rain — Water Your Servants, Animals, and Dead Land
daily_rain_request_servants_animals.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ وَبَهَائِمَكَ وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ وَأَحْيِ بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ
daily_rain_request_servants_animals.meaningEn: O Allah, give water to Your servants and Your animals, spread Your mercy, and revive Your dead land.
daily_rain_request_servants_animals.transliteration: Allāhumma-sqi ʿibādaka wa bahāʾimaka, wanshur raḥmataka, wa aḥyi baladakal-mayyit.
daily_rain_request_servants_animals.purposeEn: Asking Allah to send rain as mercy to people, animals, and the land.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 1176
The report gives this wording for seeking rain and is graded Hasan by al-Albani.

daily_rain_request_allahumma_sqina_three.title: Asking for Rain — O Allah, Give Us Rain Three Times
daily_rain_request_allahumma_sqina_three.purposeEn: A brief authentic supplication for rain.
daily_rain_request_allahumma_sqina_three.practiceEn: Say the supplication three times, following the cited report.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 1013
Anas reported that the Prophet ﷺ raised his hands and repeated this supplication three times when asked to pray for rain.

daily_rain_when_falls_beneficial.title: When It Rains — A Beneficial Downpour
daily_rain_when_falls_beneficial.meaningEn: May it be a beneficial downpour.
daily_rain_when_falls_beneficial.purposeEn: Asking that the falling rain be beneficial.
daily_rain_when_falls_beneficial.whenToSayEn: When rain begins or is seen falling.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 1032
Aishah reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used this wording when he saw rain.

daily_after_rain_grace_mercy.title: After Rainfall — By Allah's Grace and Mercy
daily_after_rain_grace_mercy.meaningEn: We have been given rain by Allah's grace and mercy.
daily_after_rain_grace_mercy.purposeEn: Attributing rainfall to Allah's grace and mercy.
sources: Sahih Muslim 71
The hadith contrasts attributing rain to Allah's grace and mercy with attributing it to stars; this exact statement is recorded in Sahih Muslim.

daily_rain_clear_skies_hawalayna.title: When Rain Is Excessive — Around Us, Not Upon Us
daily_rain_clear_skies_hawalayna.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلَا عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الْآكَامِ وَالْجِبَالِ وَالْآجَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَالْأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
daily_rain_clear_skies_hawalayna.meaningEn: O Allah, let it rain around us and not upon us; upon the plateaus, mountains, wooded areas, hills, valleys, and places where trees grow.
daily_rain_clear_skies_hawalayna.transliteration: Allāhumma ḥawālaynā wa lā ʿalaynā. Allāhumma ʿalal-ākāmi wal-jibāli wal-ājāmi waẓ-ẓirābi wal-awdiyati wa manābitish-shajar.
daily_rain_clear_skies_hawalayna.purposeEn: Asking Allah to divert excessive rain away from populated areas without asking for the blessing of rain to cease everywhere.
daily_rain_clear_skies_hawalayna.whenToSayEn: When rain becomes harmful or excessive and clear skies are needed locally.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 1013
Anas reported that the Prophet ﷺ used this wording when asked to supplicate for excessive rain to be withheld.

daily_crescent_moon_grading_differs.title: Upon Sighting the Crescent Moon — Grading Differs
daily_crescent_moon_grading_differs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَهْلِلْهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
daily_crescent_moon_grading_differs.meaningEn: O Allah, bring this crescent upon us with blessing and faith, safety and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.
daily_crescent_moon_grading_differs.transliteration: Allāhumma ahlilhu ʿalaynā bil-yumni wal-īmān, was-salāmati wal-Islām, Rabbī wa Rabbukallāh.
daily_crescent_moon_grading_differs.purposeEn: A reported supplication upon sighting the crescent.
daily_crescent_moon_grading_differs.whenToSayEn: Upon seeing the new crescent moon.
sources: Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 3451

At-Tirmidhi called the report Hasan Gharib, while the current Darussalam display grades it Daʿif. Al-Albani graded it Sahih in Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3451 and Hasan in Sahih al-Jamiʿ 4726, and Shuʿayb al-Arnaʾut graded it Hasan through supporting reports (Musnad Ahmad 1397), while Ibn Maʿin and others criticized its narrator Sulayman al-Madani. The app therefore labels this entry 'Grading Differs' instead of flattening the disagreement into an unqualified authenticity claim.

daily_food_after_bukhari_abundant_praise.title: After Completing a Meal — Abundant Blessed Praise
daily_food_after_bukhari_abundant_praise.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ، رَبَّنَا
daily_food_after_bukhari_abundant_praise.meaningEn: All praise belongs to Allah—abundant, good and blessed praise; a praise that cannot be adequately repaid, is not to be abandoned, and cannot be dispensed with, our Lord.
daily_food_after_bukhari_abundant_praise.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi kathīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīh, ghayra makfiyyin wa lā muwaddaʿin wa lā mustaghnan ʿanhu, Rabbanā.
daily_food_after_bukhari_abundant_praise.purposeEn: Praising Allah with the wording reported after completing a meal.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 5458
Abu Umamah reported that the Prophet ﷺ used this wording when the dining sheet was removed after the meal.

daily_guest_for_host_bless_forgive_mercy.title: Guest's Dua for the Host — Bless, Forgive, and Have Mercy
daily_guest_for_host_bless_forgive_mercy.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ، وَارْحَمْهُمْ
daily_guest_for_host_bless_forgive_mercy.meaningEn: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided them, forgive them, and have mercy upon them.
daily_guest_for_host_bless_forgive_mercy.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lahum fīmā razaqtahum, waghfir lahum, warḥamhum.
daily_guest_for_host_bless_forgive_mercy.purposeEn: Supplicating for the host who provided food and drink.
daily_guest_for_host_bless_forgive_mercy.whenToSayEn: As a guest, when supplicating for the host after being served.
sources: Sahih Muslim 2042a
ʿAbdullah ibn Busr reported that his father asked the Prophet ﷺ to supplicate for them after hosting him, and he used this wording.

daily_for_food_drink_provider.title: For One Who Fed or Gave Drink — Feed and Give Drink
daily_for_food_drink_provider.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي وَأَسْقِ مَنْ أَسْقَانِي
daily_for_food_drink_provider.meaningEn: O Allah, feed the one who fed me and give drink to the one who gave me drink.
daily_for_food_drink_provider.transliteration: Allāhumma aṭʿim man aṭʿamanī wa asqi man asqānī.
daily_for_food_drink_provider.purposeEn: Praying for the person who provided food or drink.
daily_for_food_drink_provider.whenToSayEn: For the person who fed you or gave you something to drink.
sources: Sahih Muslim 2055a
Al-Miqdad reported this supplication from the Prophet ﷺ in the context of food and drink.

daily_break_fast_at_host.title: When Breaking Fast at Someone's Home
daily_break_fast_at_host.arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
daily_break_fast_at_host.meaningEn: May fasting people break their fast with you, may the righteous eat your food, and may the angels pray for blessings upon you.
daily_break_fast_at_host.transliteration: Afṭara ʿindakumuṣ-ṣāʾimūn, wa akala ṭaʿāmakumul-abrār, wa ṣallat ʿalaykumul-malāʾikah.
daily_break_fast_at_host.purposeEn: Supplicating for the host after eating at their home.
daily_break_fast_at_host.whenToSayEn: After eating in someone's home, including when breaking a fast there.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 3854
Anas reported that the Prophet ﷺ said this after eating bread and olive oil in Saʿd ibn ʿUbadah's home. The report is graded Sahih by al-Albani.

daily_fasting_insulted.title: When Insulted or Quarreled With While Fasting
daily_fasting_insulted.meaningEn: I am fasting; I am fasting.
daily_fasting_insulted.purposeEn: Guarding one's conduct and remembering the fast when provoked.
daily_fasting_insulted.whenToSayEn: When someone insults, slanders, or quarrels with you while you are fasting.
daily_fasting_insulted.practiceEn: Say this twice, following the cited narration.
sources: Sahih Muslim 1151a
The Prophet ﷺ instructed the fasting person who is insulted or fought with to say, 'I am fasting, I am fasting.'

daily_first_fruit_madinah.title: Upon the First Fruit — Blessing for Madinah and Its Produce
daily_first_fruit_madinah.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا وَفِي ثِمَارِنَا وَفِي مُدِّنَا وَفِي صَاعِنَا بَرَكَةً مَعَ بَرَكَةٍ
daily_first_fruit_madinah.meaningEn: O Allah, bless us in our city, in our fruits, in our mudd and in our saʿ—blessing upon blessing.
daily_first_fruit_madinah.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fī madīnatinā wa fī thimārinā wa fī muddinā wa fī ṣāʿinā barakatan maʿa barakah.
daily_first_fruit_madinah.purposeEn: The Prophet's ﷺ supplication for blessing in Madinah and its produce.
daily_first_fruit_madinah.whenToSayEn: The source context is specifically when the first fruit was brought to the Prophet ﷺ in Madinah.
daily_first_fruit_madinah.practiceEn: This wording is Madinah-specific and should not be silently generalized into a formula naming another city.
sources: Sahih Muslim 1373b
Abu Hurayrah reported that when the first fruit was brought, the Prophet ﷺ made this Madinah-specific supplication and then gave the fruit to the youngest child present.

daily_nonmuslim_sneeze_guidance.title: When a Non-Muslim Sneezes — Pray for Guidance and Rectification
daily_nonmuslim_sneeze_guidance.meaningEn: May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.
daily_nonmuslim_sneeze_guidance.purposeEn: The response authentically reported from the Prophet ﷺ to non-Muslims who sneezed in his presence.
daily_nonmuslim_sneeze_guidance.whenToSayEn: In the cited report, Jewish people deliberately sneezed in the Prophet's ﷺ presence hoping he would say 'May Allah have mercy on you.'
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 5038
The Prophet ﷺ responded to the Jewish people with this wording rather than 'Yarhamukum Allah.' The report is graded Sahih by al-Albani. The hadith does not state that they first said Alhamdulillah.

daily_newlywed_blessing.title: To the Newlywed — Blessing and Goodness
daily_newlywed_blessing.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
daily_newlywed_blessing.meaningEn: May Allah bless you, shower His blessing upon you, and bring you both together in goodness.
daily_newlywed_blessing.transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka, wa bāraka ʿalayka, wa jamaʿa baynakumā fī khayr.
daily_newlywed_blessing.whenToSayEn: When congratulating someone who has married.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 2130
Abu Hurayrah reported that the Prophet ﷺ used this wording when congratulating a person on marriage. The report is graded Sahih by al-Albani.

daily_marriage_or_camel_good_disposition.title: When Marrying or Acquiring a Camel — Ask for Its Good
daily_marriage_or_camel_good_disposition.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
daily_marriage_or_camel_good_disposition.meaningEn: O Allah, I ask You for the good in her and the good disposition upon which You created her; and I seek refuge in You from her evil and the evil disposition upon which You created her.
daily_marriage_or_camel_good_disposition.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā wa khayra mā jabaltahā ʿalayh, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā wa min sharri mā jabaltahā ʿalayh.
daily_marriage_or_camel_good_disposition.purposeEn: Seeking the good and Allah's protection from harm in the context specified by the hadith.
daily_marriage_or_camel_good_disposition.whenToSayEn: The hadith addresses marrying a woman and, separately, acquiring a camel; its historical text also mentions acquiring a servant.
daily_marriage_or_camel_good_disposition.practiceEn: The app preserves the source context and does not generalize the camel wording to every animal.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 2160
The hadith gives this wording for marriage and says to say the same kind of supplication when acquiring a camel. It is graded Hasan by al-Albani.

daily_anger_refuge_from_satan.title: When Angry — Seek Refuge with Allah from Satan
daily_anger_refuge_from_satan.meaningEn: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan.
daily_anger_refuge_from_satan.purposeEn: Seeking Allah's protection when anger rises.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 3282
The Prophet ﷺ said that saying this would cause the angry person's condition to subside. The app preserves Bukhari's exact wording and does not silently append 'ar-rajim' to the quotation.

daily_seeing_afflicted_praise.title: Upon Seeing Someone Afflicted — Praise Allah for Well-Being
daily_seeing_afflicted_praise.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
daily_seeing_afflicted_praise.meaningEn: All praise belongs to Allah Who has spared me from what He has afflicted you with and has greatly favored me over many whom He created.
daily_seeing_afflicted_praise.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhilladhī ʿāfānī mimmabtalāka bih, wa faḍḍalanī ʿalā kathīrin mimman khalaqa tafḍīlā.
daily_seeing_afflicted_praise.purposeEn: Thanking Allah for well-being while maintaining proper compassion toward the afflicted.
daily_seeing_afflicted_praise.whenToSayEn: Upon seeing someone afflicted by a trial.
daily_seeing_afflicted_praise.practiceEn: Say it privately or in a way that does not humiliate, mock, or hurt the afflicted person.
sources: Sunan Ibn Majah 3892; al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 3154; as-Silsilah as-Sahihah 2737

Al-Albani graded the Ibn ʿUmar route Hasan in Sahih Ibn Majah and authenticated the report through its supporting routes in as-Silsilah as-Sahihah. The app adds an etiquette note so the wording is not used to humiliate an afflicted person.

daily_gathering_repentance_100.title: During a Gathering — Forgive Me and Accept My Repentance
daily_gathering_repentance_100.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الْغَفُورُ
daily_gathering_repentance_100.meaningEn: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepter of repentance, the Most Forgiving.
daily_gathering_repentance_100.transliteration: Rabbighfir lī wa tub ʿalayya, innaka Antat-Tawwābul-Ghafūr.
daily_gathering_repentance_100.purposeEn: Frequently seeking forgiveness and repentance during a gathering.
daily_gathering_repentance_100.practiceEn: The Companions counted the Prophet ﷺ saying this one hundred times in a single sitting before he got up.
sources: Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 3434
Ibn ʿUmar reported that this was counted one hundred times in one sitting of the Prophet ﷺ. At-Tirmidhi called the report Hasan Sahih Gharib; the current Darussalam display grades it Sahih.

daily_gathering_expiation.title: At the End of a Gathering — Expiation of the Sitting
daily_gathering_expiation.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
daily_gathering_expiation.meaningEn: Glory and praise are Yours, O Allah. I testify that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
daily_gathering_expiation.transliteration: Subḥānaka Allāhumma wa biḥamdik, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā Anta, astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk.
daily_gathering_expiation.purposeEn: The reported expiation for what may have occurred in a gathering.
daily_gathering_expiation.whenToSayEn: When ending a sitting or gathering.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 4859
Abu Barzah reported that the Prophet ﷺ said this when intending to rise from a gathering and described it as expiation for what occurred there. Al-Albani graded the report Hasan Sahih.

daily_favor_jazakallah_khayran.title: To One Who Does You a Favor — May Allah Reward You with Good
daily_favor_jazakallah_khayran.meaningEn: May Allah reward you with goodness.
daily_favor_jazakallah_khayran.purposeEn: Thanking someone with a supplication for Allah to reward them.
daily_favor_jazakallah_khayran.whenToSayEn: When someone does you a favor or good deed.
sources: Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 2035

The Prophet ﷺ said that whoever responds to a favor by saying this has reached a high degree of praise. At-Tirmidhi called the report Hasan Jayyid Gharib; the current Darussalam display grades it Hasan.

daily_love_for_allah_reply.title: Reply to 'I Love You for Allah's Sake'
daily_love_for_allah_reply.meaningEn: May the One for whose sake you love me love you.
daily_love_for_allah_reply.purposeEn: Responding to love expressed for Allah's sake with a supplication.
daily_love_for_allah_reply.whenToSayEn: When someone tells you, 'I love you for Allah's sake.'
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 5125
Anas reported this reply in a Prophetic teaching about informing another person of love for Allah's sake. The report is graded Hasan by al-Albani.

daily_wealth_offer_abd_al_rahman_compani.title: When Offered Wealth — Companion Practice of ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn ʿAwf
daily_wealth_offer_abd_al_rahman_compani.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
daily_wealth_offer_abd_al_rahman_compani.meaningEn: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth.
daily_wealth_offer_abd_al_rahman_compani.transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik.
daily_wealth_offer_abd_al_rahman_compani.purposeEn: A Companion-sourced blessing in response to a generous offer.
daily_wealth_offer_abd_al_rahman_compani.whenToSayEn: When someone generously offers you some of his wealth, following the cited Companion example.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 2049; 3937
Authentically reported as the response of ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn ʿAwf when Saʿd ibn ar-Rabiʿ offered to share his wealth. This is Companion practice, not wording attributed directly to the Prophet ﷺ.

daily_debt_settled_blessing_praise.title: When a Debt Is Repaid — Blessing, Praise, and Repayment (Grading Differs)
daily_debt_settled_blessing_praise.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالْأَدَاءُ
daily_debt_settled_blessing_praise.meaningEn: May Allah bless you in your family and wealth. The recompense for a loan is praise and repayment.
daily_debt_settled_blessing_praise.transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik. Innamā jazāʾus-salafi al-ḥamdu wal-adāʾ.
daily_debt_settled_blessing_praise.purposeEn: Thanking and blessing the lender when a debt is repaid.
daily_debt_settled_blessing_praise.whenToSayEn: When repaying a loan or thanking the lender after the debt has been settled.
sources: Sunan an-Nasaʾi 4683; Sunan Ibn Majah 2424; Musnad Ahmad 16410

The Arabic shown follows an-Nasaʾi 4683 (al-ḥamdu wal-adāʾ). Ibn Majah 2424 and Musnad Ahmad 16410 (al-Risalah numbering; some takhrij notes cite 16457) read al-wafāʾ wal-ḥamd (fulfilment and praise). Al-Albani graded the chain Sahih, and Shuʿayb al-Arnaʾut graded Ahmad's chain Sahih, while Ibn al-Qattan criticized the route. The app therefore preserves the grading difference instead of presenting the report as unanimously authenticated.

daily_barakallah_reply_ibn_abbas_compani.title: Reply to “May Allah Bless You” — Companion Practice of Ibn ʿAbbas
daily_barakallah_reply_ibn_abbas_compani.purposeEn: Returning a blessing with good words, following the cited Companion practice.
daily_barakallah_reply_ibn_abbas_compani.whenToSayEn: When someone says “May Allah bless you.”
sources: Al-Adab al-Mufrad 1113; al-Albani, Sahih al-Adab al-Mufrad 848
Authentically reported from Ibn ʿAbbas, who said he would answer “and you” even if Pharaoh had said “May Allah bless you.” It is a Companion practice, not a direct Prophetic formula.

daily_omen_rejection.title: Rejecting Evil Omens — All Omens Belong to Allah
daily_omen_rejection.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا طَيْرَ إِلَّا طَيْرُكَ، وَلَا خَيْرَ إِلَّا خَيْرُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
daily_omen_rejection.meaningEn: O Allah, there is no omen except what You decree, no good except Your good, and none worthy of worship besides You.
daily_omen_rejection.transliteration: Allāhumma lā ṭayra illā ṭayruk, wa lā khayra illā khayruk, wa lā ilāha ghayruk.
daily_omen_rejection.purposeEn: Rejecting superstition and affirming reliance upon Allah.
daily_omen_rejection.whenToSayEn: When an omen or superstitious sign troubles the heart.
sources: Musnad Ahmad 2/220; Hisn al-Muslim 205; as-Silsilah as-Sahihah 1065
Hisn al-Muslim cites this wording from Ahmad and Ibn as-Sunni and references al-Albani’s authentication in as-Silsilah as-Sahihah.

daily_mount_transport_opening.title: Mounting Transport — Begin with Allah’s Name and Praise
daily_mount_transport_opening.meaningEn: In the name of Allah, and all praise is for Allah.
daily_mount_transport_opening.purposeEn: Beginning the transmitted mounting remembrance before the canonical Quran verses.
daily_mount_transport_opening.whenToSayEn: When putting a foot on or beginning to mount an animal or means of transport.
daily_mount_transport_opening.practiceEn: After this opening, recite the existing canonical Quran card quran_43_13_14 (Qur’an 43:13–14). Quran Arabic is intentionally not duplicated in this hadith card.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 2602; Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 3446

The report of ʿAli describes saying Bismillah when placing the foot in the stirrup and Alhamdulillah after mounting, then reciting Qur’an 43:13–14. At-Tirmidhi called the report Hasan Sahih; the Quran portion remains canonical in the app.

daily_mount_transport_after_quran.title: Mounting Transport — Praise, Takbir, and Forgiveness After Qur’an 43:13–14
daily_mount_transport_after_quran.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
daily_mount_transport_after_quran.meaningEn: All praise is for Allah, three times. Allah is the Greatest, three times. Glory be to You, O Allah. I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
daily_mount_transport_after_quran.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāh, al-ḥamdu lillāh, al-ḥamdu lillāh. Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar, Allāhu akbar. Subḥānaka Allāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī, faghfir lī, fa-innahu lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā Ant.
daily_mount_transport_after_quran.purposeEn: Completing the transmitted mounting remembrance with praise, takbir, and repentance.
daily_mount_transport_after_quran.whenToSayEn: After reciting the canonical Qur’an 43:13–14 as part of the mounting remembrance.
daily_mount_transport_after_quran.practiceEn: Say Alhamdulillah three times, Allahu Akbar three times, then the forgiveness supplication. The Quran verses themselves remain in quran_43_13_14.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 2602; Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 3446
The report of ʿAli gives these words after Qur’an 43:13–14. At-Tirmidhi called the report Hasan Sahih; al-Albani also authenticated the report. The Quran text is not copied into this card.

daily_travel_main_supplication.title: Travel — Righteousness, Ease, and Protection
daily_travel_main_supplication.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
daily_travel_main_supplication.meaningEn: O Allah, we ask You in this journey for righteousness and piety and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and fold its distance for us. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian of the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, a distressing sight, and an unhappy return concerning wealth and family.
daily_travel_main_supplication.transliteration: Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka fī safarinā hādhal-birra wat-taqwā, wa minal-ʿamali mā tarḍā. Allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā waṭwi ʿannā buʿdah. Allāhumma Antaṣ-ṣāḥibu fis-safar, wal-khalīfatu fil-ahl. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthāʾis-safar, wa kaʾābatil-manẓar, wa sūʾil-munqalabi fil-māli wal-ahl.
daily_travel_main_supplication.purposeEn: The main authentic supplication for travel, separated from its canonical Quran portion.
daily_travel_main_supplication.whenToSayEn: When setting out on a journey, after the travel takbir and the canonical Qur’an 43:13–14.
daily_travel_main_supplication.practiceEn: The cited hadith begins with three takbirs and Qur’an 43:13–14. Use the existing canonical quran_43_13_14 card for those verses, then recite this non-Quran supplication.
sources: Sahih Muslim 1342

Ibn ʿUmar reported this travel supplication in Sahih Muslim. The hadith also contains Qur’an 43:13–14, which the app continues to resolve from its protected canonical Quran source rather than duplicating here.

daily_enter_town_village.title: Entering a Town or Village — Ask for Its Good (Grading Discussed)
daily_enter_town_village.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
daily_enter_town_village.meaningEn: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and what they shade, Lord of the seven earths and what they carry, Lord of the devils and whom they mislead, and Lord of the winds and what they scatter: I ask You for the good of this town, its people, and what is in it, and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of its people, and what is in it.
daily_enter_town_village.transliteration: Allāhumma Rabbas-samāwātis-sabʿi wa mā aẓlalna, wa Rabbal-araḍīnas-sabʿi wa mā aqlalna, wa Rabbash-shayāṭīni wa mā aḍlalna, wa Rabbar-riyāḥi wa mā dharayna. Asʾaluka khayra hādhihil-qaryati wa khayra ahlihā wa khayra mā fīhā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri ahlihā wa sharri mā fīhā.
daily_enter_town_village.purposeEn: Asking Allah for the good of a place and protection from its harm when entering it.
daily_enter_town_village.whenToSayEn: When approaching or entering a town or village.
sources: Hisn al-Muslim 208; Ibn Khuzaymah 2565; al-Hakim 2/100

Hadith critics discussed individual routes. Al-Albani authenticated the report in Sahih Ibn Khuzaymah, and al-Hakim judged its chain sound, while al-Bayhaqi noted weakness in another route. The app preserves that grading discussion.

daily_transport_stumble_bismillah.title: When an Animal or Vehicle Stumbles — Say Bismillah
daily_transport_stumble_bismillah.purposeEn: Using Allah’s Name rather than cursing Satan when a mount or transport stumbles.
daily_transport_stumble_bismillah.whenToSayEn: When a ridden animal or means of transport stumbles or falters.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 4982
The report instructs saying Bismillah rather than “May Satan perish” when the mount stumbles. Al-Albani graded it Sahih. This Arabic is intentionally reused because the context is distinct.

daily_traveller_to_resident_trust.title: Traveller to Resident — I Entrust You to Allah
daily_traveller_to_resident_trust.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
daily_traveller_to_resident_trust.meaningEn: I entrust you to Allah, with Whom deposits are never lost.
daily_traveller_to_resident_trust.purposeEn: Entrusting those remaining behind to Allah’s protection.
daily_traveller_to_resident_trust.whenToSayEn: When a traveller says farewell to residents, family, or companions.
sources: Sunan Ibn Majah 2825; Musnad Ahmad 9230; Hisn al-Muslim 211
Reported from the Prophet ﷺ as a farewell wording for travel; Hisn al-Muslim cites al-Albani’s authentication.

daily_resident_to_traveller_trust.title: Resident to Traveller — I Entrust Your Religion and Final Deeds
daily_resident_to_traveller_trust.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
daily_resident_to_traveller_trust.meaningEn: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust, and the conclusions of your deeds.
daily_resident_to_traveller_trust.transliteration: Astawdiʿullāha dīnaka wa amānataka, wa khawātīma ʿamalik.
daily_resident_to_traveller_trust.purposeEn: A Prophetic farewell supplication for a traveller.
daily_resident_to_traveller_trust.whenToSayEn: When bidding farewell to a traveller.
sources: Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 3443; Sunan Abi Dawud 2600; Hisn al-Muslim 212
Reported as a Prophetic farewell to a traveller and authenticated by al-Albani in the cited collections.

daily_resident_to_traveller_taqwa.title: Resident to Traveller — Taqwa, Forgiveness, and Goodness
daily_resident_to_traveller_taqwa.arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ
daily_resident_to_traveller_taqwa.meaningEn: May Allah provide you with piety, forgive your sin, and make goodness easy for you wherever you are.
daily_resident_to_traveller_taqwa.transliteration: Zawwadakallāhut-taqwā, wa ghafara dhanbaka, wa yassara lakal-khayra ḥaythumā kunt.
daily_resident_to_traveller_taqwa.purposeEn: Supplicating for a traveller’s piety, forgiveness, and goodness.
daily_resident_to_traveller_taqwa.whenToSayEn: When giving a traveller farewell advice and supplication.
sources: Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 3444
At-Tirmidhi called the report Hasan Gharib; al-Albani graded it Hasan Sahih.

daily_travel_ascending_takbir.title: While Ascending During Travel — Takbir
daily_travel_ascending_takbir.purposeEn: The authentic travel remembrance for ascending.
daily_travel_ascending_takbir.whenToSayEn: When ascending a height during travel.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 2993; Hisn al-Muslim 214
Jabir reported that the Companions said Allahu Akbar when ascending and Subhanallah when descending. The short Arabic is intentionally context-specific.

daily_travel_descending_tasbih.title: While Descending During Travel — Tasbih
daily_travel_descending_tasbih.purposeEn: The authentic travel remembrance for descending.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 2993; Hisn al-Muslim 214
Jabir reported that the Companions said Allahu Akbar when ascending and Subhanallah when descending. The short Arabic is intentionally context-specific.

daily_traveller_dawn.title: Traveller at Dawn — Praise, Companionship, and Refuge from the Fire
daily_traveller_dawn.arabic: سَمِعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ وَحُسْنِ بَلَائِهِ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صَاحِبْنَا وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ
daily_traveller_dawn.meaningEn: Let a hearer hear our praise of Allah and His good favor upon us. Our Lord, accompany us and bestow Your favor upon us. I seek refuge in Allah from the Fire.
daily_traveller_dawn.transliteration: Samiʿa sāmiʿun biḥamdillāhi wa ḥusni balāʾihi ʿalaynā. Rabbanā ṣāḥibnā wa afḍil ʿalaynā, ʿāʾidhan billāhi minan-nār.
daily_traveller_dawn.purposeEn: The remembrance reported from the Prophet ﷺ as dawn approached during travel.
sources: Sahih Muslim 2718; Hisn al-Muslim 215

Abu Hurayrah reported this wording in Sahih Muslim in the context of the Prophet ﷺ travelling as dawn approached. Hisn al-Muslim prints the opening as samiʿa sāmiʿun; editions of Sahih Muslim also vocalize it sammaʿa sāmiʿun, and al-Nawawi discusses both readings. This card follows the Hisn wording while preserving the variant note.

daily_lodging_refuge.title: When Stopping or Lodging Somewhere — Refuge in Allah’s Perfect Words
daily_lodging_refuge.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
daily_lodging_refuge.meaningEn: I seek refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil of what He created.
daily_lodging_refuge.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
daily_lodging_refuge.purposeEn: Seeking Allah’s protection upon lodging in a place.
daily_lodging_refuge.whenToSayEn: When stopping at or lodging in a place during travel or otherwise.
sources: Sahih Muslim 2708; Hisn al-Muslim 216

Khawlah bint Hakim reported that the Prophet ﷺ taught this wording for anyone who stops at a place. The same Arabic may also occur in another authentic context; this card preserves the lodging context.

daily_good_news_praise.title: Upon Pleasing News — Praise by Which Good Deeds Are Completed (Grading Differs)
daily_good_news_praise.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
daily_good_news_praise.meaningEn: All praise is for Allah by Whose favor righteous deeds are completed.
daily_good_news_praise.purposeEn: Praising Allah upon receiving pleasing news.
daily_good_news_praise.whenToSayEn: Upon receiving news that pleases you.
sources: Sunan Ibn Majah 3803; al-Hakim 1/499; Hisn al-Muslim 218

Reported from ʿAishah regarding the Prophet’s ﷺ wording when something pleased him. The current Darussalam display grades Ibn Majah 3803 Daʿif, while al-Albani graded the report Hasan in Sahih Ibn Majah 3081 and Sahih in Sahih al-Jamiʿ 4727, and an-Nawawi called its chain good (jayyid) in al-Adhkar. Ibn Baz graded it weak through these routes and al-Wadiʿi weak through this chain. The app preserves this grading difference.

daily_displeasing_news_praise.title: Upon Displeasing News — Praise Allah in Every Condition (Grading Differs)
daily_displeasing_news_praise.meaningEn: All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.
daily_displeasing_news_praise.purposeEn: Maintaining praise of Allah when news or circumstances are displeasing.
daily_displeasing_news_praise.whenToSayEn: Upon receiving news or encountering something displeasing.
sources: Sunan Ibn Majah 3803; al-Hakim 1/499; Hisn al-Muslim 218

The same report from ʿAishah records this wording when the Prophet ﷺ saw something he disliked. The current Darussalam display grades Ibn Majah 3803 Daʿif, while al-Albani graded the report Hasan in Sahih Ibn Majah 3081 and Sahih in Sahih al-Jamiʿ 4727, and an-Nawawi called its chain good (jayyid) in al-Adhkar. Ibn Baz graded it weak through these routes and al-Wadiʿi weak through this chain. A longer wording that adds seeking refuge from the state of the people of the Fire is listed as Daʿif by al-Albani (Daʿif al-Jamiʿ 4410); the app does not include that addition. The app preserves this grading difference.

daily_people_book_greeting_reply.title: Reply to the Greeting of People of the Book
daily_people_book_greeting_reply.purposeEn: The concise response taught in the authentic reports concerning greetings from the People of the Book.
daily_people_book_greeting_reply.whenToSayEn: When a person from the People of the Book gives the greeting described in the cited hadith.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 6258; Sahih Muslim 2163a; Hisn al-Muslim 227

The authentic reports specifically address greetings from Jews/People of the Book. The app preserves that context rather than broadening the wording into an unsupported rule for every non-Muslim interaction.

daily_insulted_believer_compensation.title: For a Believer You Have Insulted — Make It Nearness to Allah
daily_insulted_believer_compensation.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
daily_insulted_believer_compensation.meaningEn: O Allah, any believer whom I have insulted, make that for him a means of nearness to You on the Day of Resurrection.
daily_insulted_believer_compensation.transliteration: Allāhumma fa-ayyumā muʾminin sababtuhu fajʿal dhālika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawmal-qiyāmah.
daily_insulted_believer_compensation.purposeEn: The exact Prophetic supplication recorded in the cited Sahih collections.
daily_insulted_believer_compensation.whenToSayEn: When seeking Allah’s compensation for a believer whom you wrongfully insulted, following the cited Prophetic wording.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 6361; Sahih Muslim 2601
This wording is authentically reported from the Prophet ﷺ. It should not be used to excuse insulting others; it records the specific Prophetic supplication and context.

daily_praising_muslim_etiquette.title: When Praising a Fellow Muslim — Allah Is the Reckoner
daily_praising_muslim_etiquette.arabic: أَحْسِبُ فُلَانًا وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلَا أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَدًا، أَحْسِبُهُ كَذَا وَكَذَا
daily_praising_muslim_etiquette.meaningEn: I consider so-and-so to be such, and Allah is his reckoner. I do not declare anyone pure before Allah. I consider him to be such-and-such.
daily_praising_muslim_etiquette.transliteration: Aḥsibu fulānan wallāhu ḥasībuh, wa lā uzakki ʿalallāhi aḥadan, aḥsibuhu kadhā wa kadhā.
daily_praising_muslim_etiquette.purposeEn: Praising another person without claiming certainty about their standing before Allah.
daily_praising_muslim_etiquette.whenToSayEn: When praising another Muslim and one genuinely knows the praised quality.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 6162; Sahih Muslim 3000
The Prophet ﷺ instructed that if praise is necessary and the person knows that quality, it should be expressed with this qualification rather than declaring anyone pure before Allah.

daily_praised_companion_supplication.title: When You Are Praised — Companion Practice
daily_praised_companion_supplication.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
daily_praised_companion_supplication.meaningEn: O Allah, do not take me to account for what they say, and forgive me for what they do not know.
daily_praised_companion_supplication.transliteration: Allāhumma lā tuʾākhidhnī bimā yaqūlūn, waghfir lī mā lā yaʿlamūn.
daily_praised_companion_supplication.purposeEn: A Companion-sourced supplication for humility when praised.
sources: Al-Adab al-Mufrad 761; al-Albani, Sahih al-Adab al-Mufrad

Authentically reported as what one of the Companions would say when praised. It is not presented as direct Prophetic wording. The additional popular phrase “make me better than they think” is not merged into this authenticated report.

daily_hajj_talbiyah.title: Talbiyah for Hajj or ʿUmrah
daily_hajj_talbiyah.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
daily_hajj_talbiyah.meaningEn: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am; You have no partner; here I am. Surely all praise, favor, and dominion belong to You. You have no partner.
daily_hajj_talbiyah.transliteration: Labbayka Allāhumma labbayk, labbayka lā sharīka laka labbayk. Innal-ḥamda wan-niʿmata laka wal-mulk, lā sharīka lak.
daily_hajj_talbiyah.purposeEn: The Talbiyah authentically transmitted from the Prophet ﷺ for Hajj and ʿUmrah.
daily_hajj_talbiyah.whenToSayEn: After entering ihram for Hajj or ʿUmrah and during the prescribed periods of Talbiyah.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 1549; Sahih Muslim 1184a; Hisn al-Muslim 233
Ibn ʿUmar reported this Talbiyah from the Prophet ﷺ in the two Sahih collections.

daily_hajj_takbir_black_stone_jamarat.title: Hajj & ʿUmrah — Takbir at the Black Stone and with Each Jamarat Pebble
daily_hajj_takbir_black_stone_jamarat.purposeEn: A single source-of-truth card for Takbir in the two authenticated Hajj/ʿUmrah contexts.
daily_hajj_takbir_black_stone_jamarat.whenToSayEn: When passing/pointing to the Black Stone and with each pebble thrown at the Jamarat, according to the respective rites.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 1613; Sahih al-Bukhari 1753; Hisn al-Muslim 234, 239
Authentic reports establish Takbir at the Black Stone and with each pebble at the Jamarat. One card is used for both rites to avoid duplicating identical Arabic within the Hajj collection.

daily_safa_marwah_tahlil.title: At Safa and Marwah — Tawhid, Fulfilled Promise, and Victory
daily_safa_marwah_tahlil.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
daily_safa_marwah_tahlil.meaningEn: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, aided His servant, and alone defeated the confederates.
daily_safa_marwah_tahlil.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdah, anjaza waʿdah, wa naṣara ʿabdah, wa hazamal-aḥzāba waḥdah.
daily_safa_marwah_tahlil.purposeEn: The authentic dhikr at Safa and Marwah, with personal supplication between repetitions.
daily_safa_marwah_tahlil.whenToSayEn: While standing at Safa and Marwah during Saʿy.
daily_safa_marwah_tahlil.practiceEn: Near Safa, recite Qur’an 2:158 as reported, then face the qiblah, glorify and magnify Allah, say this dhikr, make personal dua, and repeat the dhikr-and-dua cycle three times. Do at Marwah as at Safa. Qur’an 2:158 is not duplicated into the dua catalog because it is not itself a standalone Quranic dua.
sources: Sahih Muslim 1218a; Hisn al-Muslim 236
Jabir’s detailed Hajj narration in Sahih Muslim records this dhikr at Safa and the same practice at Marwah. The app deliberately does not create a Quranic-dua entry for 2:158.

daily_arafah_tahlil.title: Day of ʿArafah — Tawhid Remembrance (Grading Differs)
daily_arafah_tahlil.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
daily_arafah_tahlil.meaningEn: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.
daily_arafah_tahlil.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
daily_arafah_tahlil.purposeEn: The well-known tawhid remembrance reported for the Day of ʿArafah.
sources: Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 3585; Hisn al-Muslim 237

At-Tirmidhi called the report Hasan Gharib but noted weakness in a transmitter; the current Darussalam display grades it Daʿif, while other scholars have strengthened the report. The app therefore labels the grading difference rather than calling it unqualified Sahih.

daily_amazement_subhanallah.title: At Times of Amazement or Delight — Subhanallah
daily_amazement_subhanallah.purposeEn: A brief authentic remembrance at moments of amazement or delight.
daily_amazement_subhanallah.whenToSayEn: At a moment of amazement or something that delights.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari; Sahih Muslim; Hisn al-Muslim 240
Hisn al-Muslim cites reports in Bukhari and Muslim for saying Subhanallah in this context. This short Arabic is intentionally context-specific.

daily_body_pain_refuge.title: When Feeling Pain — Bismillah and Refuge in Allah’s Power
daily_body_pain_refuge.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
daily_body_pain_refuge.meaningEn: In the name of Allah. I seek refuge in Allah and in His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.
daily_body_pain_refuge.transliteration: Bismillāh. Aʿūdhu billāhi wa qudratihi min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir.
daily_body_pain_refuge.purposeEn: The authentic Prophetic practice for bodily pain.
daily_body_pain_refuge.whenToSayEn: When feeling pain in the body.
daily_body_pain_refuge.practiceEn: Place your hand on the painful area. Say Bismillah three times, then say the refuge phrase seven times.
sources: Sahih Muslim 2202; Hisn al-Muslim 243
Sahih Muslim records placing the hand on the painful place, saying Bismillah three times, then saying the refuge phrase seven times.

daily_startled_tahlil.title: When Startled — La Ilaha Illallah
daily_startled_tahlil.meaningEn: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.
daily_startled_tahlil.purposeEn: Turning immediately to tawhid when startled.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari; Sahih Muslim; Hisn al-Muslim 245
Hisn al-Muslim cites Bukhari and Muslim for this wording in the context of sudden alarm. The Arabic also appears in another authentic context, so this is intentional contextual reuse.

daily_slaughter_bismillah_takbir.title: When Slaughtering or Offering a Sacrifice — Allah’s Name and Takbir
daily_slaughter_bismillah_takbir.meaningEn: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
daily_slaughter_bismillah_takbir.purposeEn: The securely established core remembrance at slaughter.
daily_slaughter_bismillah_takbir.whenToSayEn: At the time of lawful slaughter or sacrifice.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 7399; Sahih Muslim 1966a

Authentic reports establish mentioning Allah’s Name and saying Takbir at the sacrifice. The app keeps this securely established core separate instead of silently combining additional wordings from distinct reports into one quotation.

daily_rebellious_devils_refuge.title: Protection from Rebellious Devils — Allah’s Perfect Words
daily_rebellious_devils_refuge.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ، مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَذَرَأَ وَبَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
daily_rebellious_devils_refuge.meaningEn: I seek refuge in Allah’s perfect words, which neither the righteous nor the wicked can surpass, from the evil of what He created, produced and spread; from the evil of what descends from the sky and what rises into it; from the evil of what He spread in the earth and what comes out of it; from the trials of night and day; and from every night visitor except one who comes with good, O Most Merciful.
daily_rebellious_devils_refuge.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikalimātillāhit-tāmmāti allatī lā yujāwizuhunna barrun wa lā fājir, min sharri mā khalaqa wa dharaʾa wa baraʾa, wa min sharri mā yanzilu minas-samāʾ, wa min sharri mā yaʿruju fīhā, wa min sharri mā dharaʾa fil-arḍ, wa min sharri mā yakhruju minhā, wa min sharri fitanil-layli wan-nahār, wa min sharri kulli ṭāriqin illā ṭāriqan yaṭruqu bikhayrin yā Raḥmān.
daily_rebellious_devils_refuge.purposeEn: A comprehensive authentic refuge from frightening and rebellious evil.
daily_rebellious_devils_refuge.whenToSayEn: When seeking protection from the plots of rebellious devils or frightening night disturbances.
sources: Musnad Ahmad 15499; Hisn al-Muslim 247

This app uses the connected report from ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn Khanbash. Ibn Baz judged its chain Sahih and al-Albani authenticated this route. It does not rely on the weaker Khalid ibn al-Walid route sometimes associated with similar wording.

daily_seeking_forgiveness_al_azim.title: Seeking Forgiveness — The Ever-Living, the Sustainer
daily_seeking_forgiveness_al_azim.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
daily_seeking_forgiveness_al_azim.meaningEn: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Magnificent, besides Whom none has the right to be worshipped, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.
daily_seeking_forgiveness_al_azim.transliteration: Astaghfirullāhal-ʿAẓīmal-ladhī lā ilāha illā Huwal-Ḥayyul-Qayyūmu wa atūbu ilayh.
daily_seeking_forgiveness_al_azim.purposeEn: A transmitted formula of seeking forgiveness and repentance.
daily_seeking_forgiveness_al_azim.whenToSayEn: When seeking Allah’s forgiveness and repentance.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 1517; Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 3577; Hisn al-Muslim 250
The report is authenticated by al-Albani in Sahih at-Tirmidhi. This is added as a distinct formula while existing daily istighfar entries remain unchanged.
