prayer_opening_separation_sins.title: Standing — Opening: Separation and Cleansing from Sins
prayer_opening_separation_sins.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
prayer_opening_separation_sins.meaningEn: O Allah, distance me from my sins as You have distanced the East from the West. O Allah, cleanse me of my sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt. O Allah, wash away my sins with water, snow, and hail.
prayer_opening_separation_sins.transliteration: Allāhumma bāʿid baynī wa bayna khaṭāyāya kamā bāʿadta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib. Allāhumma naqqinī min khaṭāyāya kamā yunaqqath-thawbul-abyaḍu minad-danas. Allāhumma ighsil khaṭāyāya bil-māʾi wath-thalji wal-barad.
prayer_opening_separation_sins.purposeEn: An authentic opening supplication asking Allah for cleansing from sin.
prayer_opening_separation_sins.whenToSayEn: After the opening takbir and before Quran recitation.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 744; Sahih Muslim 598a-b

Both Sahih collections record Abu Hurairah asking what the Prophet ﷺ said in the pause between the opening takbir and recitation. This is one authentic opening formula; other authentic opening supplications also exist.

prayer_ruku_glory_mighty.title: Ruku — Glory to My Lord, the Mighty
prayer_ruku_glory_mighty.meaningEn: Glory be to my Lord, the Mighty.
sources: Sahih Muslim 772
Sahih Muslim records Hudhayfah praying at night with the Prophet ﷺ and hearing this dhikr in ruku.

prayer_ruku_sujud_forgiveness.title: Ruku & Sujud — Glory, Praise, and Forgiveness
prayer_ruku_sujud_forgiveness.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
prayer_ruku_sujud_forgiveness.meaningEn: Glory be to You, O Allah our Lord, and praise be to You. O Allah, forgive me.
prayer_ruku_sujud_forgiveness.transliteration: Subḥānaka Allāhumma Rabbanā wa biḥamdik, Allāhummaghfir lī.
prayer_ruku_sujud_forgiveness.purposeEn: Glorification, praise, and seeking forgiveness in ruku and sujud.
sources: Sahih Muslim 484a; Sahih al-Bukhari 794
Aishah reported that the Prophet ﷺ frequently said this in his bowing and prostration.

prayer_rise_from_ruku_praise.title: Rising from Ruku — Allah Hears the One Who Praises Him
prayer_rise_from_ruku_praise.arabic: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ
prayer_rise_from_ruku_praise.meaningEn: Allah hears the one who praises Him. O Allah, our Lord, to You belongs all praise.
prayer_rise_from_ruku_praise.transliteration: Samiʿallāhu liman ḥamidah. Allāhumma Rabbanā wa lakal-ḥamd.
prayer_rise_from_ruku_praise.purposeEn: Praise of Allah when rising from ruku.
prayer_rise_from_ruku_praise.whenToSayEn: When rising from ruku and standing upright.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 795-796; Sahih Muslim 772
The sources preserve authentic wording for the imam/individual and the response of the follower. Juristic details about who says each phrase are not reduced here to a school-specific ruling.

prayer_rise_blessed_praise.title: Standing after Ruku — Abundant Blessed Praise
prayer_rise_blessed_praise.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
prayer_rise_blessed_praise.meaningEn: Our Lord, to You belongs all praise—abundant, good, and blessed praise.
prayer_rise_blessed_praise.transliteration: Rabbanā wa lakal-ḥamd, ḥamdan kathīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīh.
prayer_rise_blessed_praise.purposeEn: A praised formula after ruku; the Prophet ﷺ said that more than thirty angels competed to record it first.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 799
A Companion said these words after the Prophet ﷺ rose from ruku, and the Prophet ﷺ approved them and reported the angels competing to write them.

prayer_sujud_glory_highest.title: Sujud — Glory to My Lord, the Most High
prayer_sujud_glory_highest.meaningEn: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.
sources: Sahih Muslim 772
Sahih Muslim records Hudhayfah hearing the Prophet ﷺ say this in prostration during the night prayer.

prayer_sujud_all_sins.title: Sujud — Forgiveness for Every Sin
prayer_sujud_all_sins.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
prayer_sujud_all_sins.meaningEn: O Allah, forgive me all my sins: the small and the great, the first and the last, the public and the secret.
prayer_sujud_all_sins.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī dhanbī kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa ākhirahu, wa ʿalāniyatahu wa sirrahu.
prayer_sujud_all_sins.purposeEn: A comprehensive supplication for forgiveness during sujud.
sources: Sahih Muslim 483
Abu Hurairah reported that the Prophet ﷺ used to say this while prostrating.

prayer_sujud_tilawah_creation.title: Sujud at-Tilawah — My Face Prostrates to Its Creator
prayer_sujud_tilawah_creation.arabic: سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ
prayer_sujud_tilawah_creation.meaningEn: My face has prostrated to the One Who created it and brought forth its hearing and sight by His might and power.
prayer_sujud_tilawah_creation.transliteration: Sajada wajhī lilladhī khalaqahu wa shaqqa samʿahu wa baṣarahu biḥawlihi wa quwwatih.
prayer_sujud_tilawah_creation.purposeEn: A transmitted remembrance for the prostration of recitation.
prayer_sujud_tilawah_creation.whenToSayEn: During a prostration of Quran recitation (sujud at-tilawah).
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 1414
The report is graded Sahih by Al-Albani and explicitly records this wording in the Prophet's ﷺ prostration during Quran recitation at night.

prayer_sujud_tilawah_reward.title: Sujud at-Tilawah — Reward, Removal of Sin, and Acceptance
prayer_sujud_tilawah_reward.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْرًا، وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْرًا، وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْرًا، وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدَ
prayer_sujud_tilawah_reward.meaningEn: O Allah, record for me through it a reward with You, remove from me through it a sin, store it for me with You as a treasure, and accept it from me as You accepted it from Your servant Dawud.
prayer_sujud_tilawah_reward.transliteration: Allāhummaktub lī bihā ʿindaka ajran, wa ḍaʿ ʿannī bihā wizran, wajʿalhā lī ʿindaka dhukhran, wa taqabbalhā minnī kamā taqabbaltahā min ʿabdika Dāwūd.
prayer_sujud_tilawah_reward.purposeEn: Asking Allah for reward, removal of sin, stored reward, and acceptance in sujud at-tilawah.
prayer_sujud_tilawah_reward.whenToSayEn: During a prostration of Quran recitation (sujud at-tilawah).
sources: Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 579
At-Tirmidhi called the report Hasan Gharib and the current Darussalam display grades it Hasan. Ibn ʿAbbas reported hearing the Prophet ﷺ say the wording in a prostration of recitation.

prayer_between_sujud_mercy_guidance.title: Between the Two Sujud — Forgive, Mercy, Guidance, and Provision
prayer_between_sujud_mercy_guidance.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَعَافِنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
prayer_between_sujud_mercy_guidance.meaningEn: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, grant me well-being, guide me, and provide for me.
prayer_between_sujud_mercy_guidance.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī, warḥamnī, wa ʿāfinī, wahdinī, warzuqnī.
prayer_between_sujud_mercy_guidance.purposeEn: A transmitted supplication between the two prostrations asking for forgiveness, mercy, well-being, guidance, and provision.
prayer_between_sujud_mercy_guidance.whenToSayEn: While sitting between the two prostrations.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 850

This wording is graded Hasan by Al-Albani on Sunnah.com. Another authentic wording, 'Rabbi-ghfir lī, Rabbi-ghfir lī,' is reported in Sunan Abi Dawud 874; the app does not imply there is only one valid formula.

prayer_tashahhud_ibn_masud.title: Tashahhud — At-Tahiyyat
prayer_tashahhud_ibn_masud.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
prayer_tashahhud_ibn_masud.meaningEn: All greetings, prayers, and pure words belong to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and blessings. Peace be upon us and upon Allah's righteous servants. I testify that none has the right to be worshiped except Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
prayer_tashahhud_ibn_masud.transliteration: At-taḥiyyātu lillāhi waṣ-ṣalawātu waṭ-ṭayyibāt. As-salāmu ʿalayka ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa raḥmatullāhi wa barakātuh. As-salāmu ʿalaynā wa ʿalā ʿibādillāhiṣ-ṣāliḥīn. Ash-hadu an lā ilāha illallāh, wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh.
prayer_tashahhud_ibn_masud.purposeEn: The tashahhud taught by the Prophet ﷺ to Ibn Masud and the Companions.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 831

Sahih al-Bukhari records this tashahhud wording from Ibn Masud. Other authentic tashahhud wordings are also transmitted; this app preserves one rigorously sourced form rather than declaring it exclusive.

prayer_salawat_ibrahimiyyah.title: After Tashahhud — Salat upon the Prophet ﷺ
prayer_salawat_ibrahimiyyah.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
prayer_salawat_ibrahimiyyah.meaningEn: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.
prayer_salawat_ibrahimiyyah.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd. Allāhumma bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā bārakta ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.
prayer_salawat_ibrahimiyyah.purposeEn: Sending salat and blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ after the tashahhud.
prayer_salawat_ibrahimiyyah.whenToSayEn: After the tashahhud in the prayer sitting.
sources: Sahih Muslim 406a; Sahih al-Bukhari 3370, 6357
Sahih Muslim explicitly places this chapter after the tashahhud. Several authentic salawat wordings exist; this entry uses the Ka'b ibn Ujrah wording preserved in Bukhari and Muslim.

prayer_after_salah_istighfar_salam.title: After Every Fard — Istighfar and As-Salam
prayer_after_salah_istighfar_salam.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
prayer_after_salah_istighfar_salam.meaningEn: I seek Allah's forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, Possessor of Majesty and Honor.
prayer_after_salah_istighfar_salam.transliteration: Astaghfirullāh, astaghfirullāh, astaghfirullāh. Allāhumma Antas-Salāmu wa minkas-salām, tabārakta dhal-jalāli wal-ikrām.
prayer_after_salah_istighfar_salam.purposeEn: Seeking forgiveness and praising Allah immediately after salah.
prayer_after_salah_istighfar_salam.whenToSayEn: Immediately after the salam of each obligatory (Fard) prayer.
prayer_after_salah_istighfar_salam.practiceEn: Begin the guided post-Fard set here: say Astaghfirullāh three times, then say Allāhumma Antas-Salām once. Sahih Muslim 591 explicitly preserves this internal order.
sources: Sahih Muslim 591
Thawban reported that when the Prophet ﷺ finished his prayer, he sought forgiveness three times and then said this supplication.

prayer_end_help_remembrance.title: After Every Fard — Help Me Remember and Worship You Well
prayer_end_help_remembrance.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
prayer_end_help_remembrance.meaningEn: O Allah, help me to remember You, thank You, and worship You well.
prayer_end_help_remembrance.transliteration: Allāhumma aʿinnī ʿalā dhikrika wa shukrika wa ḥusni ʿibādatik.
prayer_end_help_remembrance.purposeEn: Seeking Allah's help for remembrance, gratitude, and excellent worship.
prayer_end_help_remembrance.whenToSayEn: At the end of every prescribed prayer.
prayer_end_help_remembrance.practiceEn: Say once. The hadith wording uses fī duburi kulli ṣalāh (at the end of every prayer). Scholars discuss the exact boundary of dubur in some contexts, so the app preserves that nuance rather than claiming one exclusive juristic placement.
sources: Sunan Abi Dawud 1522

The report is graded Sahih by Al-Albani on Sunnah.com. Its wording is fī duburi kulli ṣalāh ('at the end of every prayer'); the app preserves that wording and does not use this entry to impose one school-specific discussion about the exact boundary of dubur.

prayer_after_salah_tasbih_33.title: After Every Fard — Tasbih Variant A (33 / 33 / 33 + Tahlil)
prayer_after_salah_tasbih_33.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
prayer_after_salah_tasbih_33.meaningEn: Glory be to Allah; praise be to Allah; Allah is the Greatest. There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable.
prayer_after_salah_tasbih_33.transliteration: Subḥānallāh (33×), alḥamdulillāh (33×), Allāhu akbar (33×). Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
prayer_after_salah_tasbih_33.purposeEn: A prescribed remembrance after prayer. The cited report states forgiveness even if sins are like the foam of the sea.
prayer_after_salah_tasbih_33.practiceEn: Authentic Variant A: Subḥānallāh 33×, Alḥamdulillāh 33×, Allāhu Akbar 33×; then complete one hundred with the tahlil once. Variant B below is an alternative authentic form; do not present both variants as one required combined count.
sources: Sahih Muslim 597a
Sahih Muslim specifies thirty-three tasbih, thirty-three tahmid, thirty-three takbir, then the tahlil to complete one hundred.

prayer_after_fard_tahlil_no_preventer.title: After Every Fard — Tahlil and No One Can Withhold What Allah Gives
prayer_after_fard_tahlil_no_preventer.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
prayer_after_fard_tahlil_no_preventer.meaningEn: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and wealth or status cannot benefit anyone against You.
prayer_after_fard_tahlil_no_preventer.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayta, wa lā muʿṭiya limā manaʿta, wa lā yanfaʿu dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
prayer_after_fard_tahlil_no_preventer.purposeEn: Affirming Allah's oneness, dominion, praise, complete power, and complete control over benefit and withholding after the obligatory prayer.
prayer_after_fard_tahlil_no_preventer.whenToSayEn: After the salam of each obligatory (Fard) prayer.
prayer_after_fard_tahlil_no_preventer.practiceEn: Say once as a post-prayer remembrance. This is an independently transmitted Sunnah formula; the app does not claim that every post-Fard card must be recited in one rigid combined order.
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 844, 6330; Sahih Muslim 593a, 593e
Al-Mughirah ibn Shuʿbah reported that the Prophet ﷺ said this after completing the prayer and pronouncing the salam. It is preserved in both Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.

prayer_after_fard_tasbih_34_variant.title: After Every Fard — Tasbih Variant B (33 / 33 / 34)
prayer_after_fard_tasbih_34_variant.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
prayer_after_fard_tasbih_34_variant.meaningEn: Glory be to Allah; praise be to Allah; Allah is the Greatest.
prayer_after_fard_tasbih_34_variant.purposeEn: An authentic alternative form of the prescribed remembrances after every obligatory prayer.
prayer_after_fard_tasbih_34_variant.practiceEn: Authentic Variant B: Subḥānallāh 33×, Alḥamdulillāh 33×, Allāhu Akbar 34×. This is an alternative to Variant A; the app does not instruct users to combine both variants as one required practice.
sources: Sahih Muslim 596a

Kaʿb ibn ʿUjrah reported thirty-three tasbih, thirty-three tahmid, and thirty-four takbir after every prescribed prayer. This is preserved as an alternative authentic form, not stacked as mandatory with Muslim 597a.

prayer_after_fard_ayat_al_kursi.title: After Every Fard — Ayat al-Kursi
prayer_after_fard_ayat_al_kursi.purposeEn: Reciting Ayat al-Kursi after the obligatory prayer according to the reported Abu Umamah narration.
prayer_after_fard_ayat_al_kursi.practiceEn: Recite Ayat al-Kursi once. The Quran Arabic is resolved from the app's protected canonical Quran asset; it is not copied into this catalog.
sources: Qur’an 2:255; al-Nasaʾi, as-Sunan al-Kubra 9848/9928 (edition numbering); at-Tabarani al-Kabir 7532

The Abu Umamah report states that whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer has nothing preventing entry into Paradise except death. Al-Albani graded it Sahih in Sahih at-Targhib (1595), and Ibn Hibban also authenticated it; other hadith scholars discussed aspects of the chain. The app preserves that grading nuance and resolves the Quran text only from the canonical Quran asset.

prayer_after_fard_al_ikhlas.title: After Every Fard — Surah Al-Ikhlas
prayer_after_fard_al_ikhlas.purposeEn: One of the three Surahs the Prophet ﷺ commanded ʿUqbah ibn ʿAmir to recite after every prayer.
prayer_after_fard_al_ikhlas.whenToSayEn: After each obligatory (Fard) prayer as part of the Muʿawwidhat recitation.
prayer_after_fard_al_ikhlas.practiceEn: Recite once after every prayer as part of Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas. Their three-times morning/evening practice comes from separate morning/evening evidence; Abu Dawud 1523 itself does not prescribe three repetitions after every Fard prayer.
sources: Qur’an 112:1-4; Sunan Abi Dawud 1523

ʿUqbah ibn ʿAmir reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded him to recite the Muʿawwidhat after every prayer. Abu Dawud 1523 is graded Sahih by Al-Albani. Quran Arabic is resolved only from the canonical Quran asset.

prayer_after_fard_al_falaq.purposeEn: One of the three Surahs the Prophet ﷺ commanded ʿUqbah ibn ʿAmir to recite after every prayer.
prayer_after_fard_al_falaq.whenToSayEn: After each obligatory (Fard) prayer as part of the Muʿawwidhat recitation.
prayer_after_fard_al_falaq.practiceEn: Recite once after every prayer as part of Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas. Their three-times morning/evening practice is a separate adhkar context and is not imposed here.
sources: Qur’an 113:1-5; Sunan Abi Dawud 1523

prayer_after_fard_long_tahlil.title: After Every Fard — Additional Authentic Tahlil
prayer_after_fard_long_tahlil.category: After Every Fard Prayer — Authentic Addition
prayer_after_fard_long_tahlil.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
prayer_after_fard_long_tahlil.meaningEn: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable. There is no might or power except through Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and we worship none but Him. To Him belong blessing and favor and the finest praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, sincerely devoting the religion to Him even if the disbelievers dislike it.
prayer_after_fard_long_tahlil.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh. Lā ilāha illallāhu wa lā naʿbudu illā iyyāh. Lahun-niʿmatu wa lahul-faḍlu wa lahuth-thanāʾul-ḥasan. Lā ilāha illallāhu mukhliṣīna lahud-dīna wa law karihal-kāfirūn.
prayer_after_fard_long_tahlil.purposeEn: A comprehensive tahlil and declaration of sincere worship reported after every obligatory prayer.
prayer_after_fard_long_tahlil.whenToSayEn: After the salam of each obligatory (Fard) prayer.
prayer_after_fard_long_tahlil.practiceEn: This is an additional authentic post-prayer tahlil reported independently in Sahih Muslim. It is offered as a source-backed Sunnah addition, not as a claim that every card in this guided section forms one single obligatory sequence.
sources: Sahih Muslim 594a
Ibn al-Zubayr reported saying this after every prayer and stated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used these words of tahlil after every obligatory prayer.

prayer_witr_qunut_hasan.title: Witr — Qunut of al-Hasan ibn Ali
prayer_witr_qunut_hasan.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، وَإِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
prayer_witr_qunut_hasan.meaningEn: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being, take me into Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless for me what You have given, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. You decree and none decrees over You. The one You befriend is not humiliated. Blessed and Exalted are You, our Lord.
prayer_witr_qunut_hasan.transliteration: Allāhumma ihdinī fīman hadayt, wa ʿāfinī fīman ʿāfayt, wa tawallanī fīman tawallayt, wa bārik lī fīmā aʿṭayt, wa qinī sharra mā qaḍayt, fa-innaka taqḍī wa lā yuqḍā ʿalayk, wa innahu lā yadhillu man wālayt, tabārakta Rabbanā wa taʿālayt.
prayer_witr_qunut_hasan.purposeEn: A transmitted Qunut supplication for Witr.
prayer_witr_qunut_hasan.whenToSayEn: In Witr, according to the transmitted teaching to al-Hasan ibn Ali.
sources: Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 464

At-Tirmidhi explicitly called the report Hasan and said he knew no better report from the Prophet ﷺ concerning Qunut in Witr; Sunnah.com currently also displays a Darussalam grading of Sahih. At-Tirmidhi records that scholars differed about the timing and regularity of Qunut, so this entry preserves the transmitted wording without imposing a school-specific ruling.

prayer_qunut_umar_companion.title: Qunut — Companion Formula Reported from ʿUmar
prayer_qunut_umar_companion.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالْكَافِرِينَ مُلْحِقٌ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعِينُكَ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ، وَلَا نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ وَنَخْضَعُ لَكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ مَنْ يَكْفُرُكَ
prayer_qunut_umar_companion.meaningEn: O Allah, You alone we worship; for You we pray and prostrate; toward You we strive and hasten. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment; surely Your punishment overtakes the disbelievers. O Allah, we seek Your help and Your forgiveness, praise You for all good, do not disbelieve in You, believe in You and submit to You, and renounce whoever disbelieves in You.
prayer_qunut_umar_companion.purposeEn: A companion-sourced Qunut formula preserved for source-aware study without attributing it directly to the Prophet ﷺ.
prayer_qunut_umar_companion.whenToSayEn: A Qunut formula reported from ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab. The cited report is in Fajr, and juristic use and placement of Qunut differ; this entry is not presented as a universal Witr formula.
sources: Al-Bayhaqi, as-Sunan al-Kubra 2/211 (report from ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab)

Al-Bayhaqi judged the connected report's chain authentic, and al-Albani said in Irwaʾ al-Ghalil 2/170 that its chain is authentic as a statement of ʿUmar (Hisn al-Muslim 118). This is a Companion report from ʿUmar, not a direct Prophetic hadith. Another route from ʿUmar reports his Qunut after rukuʿ with slightly different wording. The cited report places it in Fajr, and the wider juristic questions of Qunut timing, placement, and use differ, so the app does not turn it into a universal school-specific ruling.

prayer_after_witr_malik_quddus.title: After Witr — Glory to the Sovereign, the Most Holy
prayer_after_witr_malik_quddus.meaningEn: Glory be to the Sovereign, the Most Holy.
prayer_after_witr_malik_quddus.purposeEn: The remembrance reported immediately after completing Witr.
prayer_after_witr_malik_quddus.whenToSayEn: Immediately after the salam of Witr.
prayer_after_witr_malik_quddus.practiceEn: Say this three times. The cited narration states that the third time was elongated and raised.
sources: Sunan an-Nasaʾi 1753
The report records the Prophet ﷺ saying this three times after the Witr salam, elongating and raising the third. The current Sunnah.com/Darussalam display grades the report Sahih.
